offering_description.value: Provides outsourced sales, merchandising and marketing services to consumer packaged goods brands and retailers. The work is carried out in stores and through digital media and data platforms, and clients pay for the services delivered.

primary_services.value: outsourced field sales; in-store merchandising; product demonstrations; digital marketing; retail data analytics

customer_segment.value: B2B: consumer packaged goods brands and manufacturers, retailers and grocery chains

end_markets.value: consumer packaged goods; grocery and mass retail; food and beverage

revenue_model.value: service fees: fees for outsourced in-store sales and merchandising work; project or contract: contracted marketing and digital campaigns for brand clients

value_chain_position.value: service provider: runs sales and marketing execution for brands and retailers, sold to consumer goods companies; software / platform: retail execution and data platforms used by brands and retailers

geography_served.value: US national: Operates across the US, with some operations in Canada and Mexico

specialization.value: related lines: in-store sales and merchandising, digital media and marketing, data and analytics

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling directly to brands and retailers

regulatory_exposure.value: low: only normal business rules apply, such as employment and data privacy rules
